arguments.content: In the ChatGPT relay loop on Gap 6, the independent critique corrected three load-bearing issues in the membrane spatial-partitioning hypothesis. First, ChatGPT identified that annular selectivity cannot be treated as the primary nM-to-uM rescue term: with annular area fraction f=0.3 and annular/bulk selectivity S=5, mass balance gives only ~2.3x enrichment over whole-membrane average, so membrane/water partitioning is the load-bearing coefficient and annular enrichment is secondary. Second, ChatGPT caught an internal consistency issue between an 80%-VDAC dense-domain premise and a 140:1 lipid:protein experimental design, recommending a density series rather than a single-density GUV experiment. Third, ChatGPT reframed the Rimmerman Kd measurement condition as a fork rather than a rescue: delipidated VDAC1 in LDAO/PBS cannot decide native potency either direction because the lipid annulus could concentrate CBD productively, sequester it nonproductively, compete through cholesterol/cardiolipin occupancy, or alter VDAC1 conformational state. Future instances should retrieve this when working on Gap 6, CBD-VDAC1 potency, annular partitioning, or the OMM channel-surface paper, and preserve the corrected hierarchy: K_membrane/water first, annular geometry second, native-condition Kd unresolved.
